facts.fact: The Central Bank of Nigeria's draft e-payment of taxes guidelines state that an e-tax card, a debit card letting taxpayers pay tax online without visiting a bank, 'was introduced' as a payment option.

The Central Bank of Nigeria's draft guidelines set out requirements for electronic payment of all taxes, levies, duties and fees at all levels of government, with business taxes to be paid electronically on a stated timetable.
